resource: Semantic entities in one WORLD_SPATIAL_VISIBILITY snapshot or delta
allocation_impact: A snapshot carries at most 256 entities (nearest first, own actor always included); a delta at most 256 entries, a larger change is a snapshot. Encoders refuse the 257th before encoding.
boundary_tests: max=256: a snapshot of 256 entities (own actor included) encodes within 33,792 bytes and decodes
max+1=257: encode and decode both refuse the 257th entity
consumers: WORLD_SPATIAL_VISIBILITY state domain 1, snapshot type 2 and delta type 2 (capability 6 WORLD_SPATIAL_ENTITIES)
notes: Re-decided from 1 in D87 (decision section 4.4), registered with the VIS-2 schema revision. Sessions without capability 6 keep the v1 own-actor-only types.
